PCP_REQUEST
Description
Triggered on receipt of a valid PCP (Port Control Protocol) request
from a client.
Examples
when PCP_REQUEST {
     if {[PCP::request opcode] == "map" &&
             [PCP::request internal-port] == 22] } {
         log "Rejecting PCP request to map SSH"
         PCP::reject 1
    }
}
